patterns.note: A high-contrast split-screen layout with a fixed black left panel containing vertical branding and navigation, and an independently scrolling white right panel for main content.
Extremely oversized, bold, wide sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating a strong visual impact and hierarchy against smaller, legible body text.
Predominantly black and white, with vibrant gradient accents (blue-pink, green-pink) used as background fills for key section headings, providing bursts of color.

The left-hand branding and navigation panel remains sticky and fixed in the viewport, while the right-hand content area scrolls independently, revealing new sections with a subtle fade-in and slide-up effect.
Each major content section on the right panel is introduced by a large, bold heading, often set against a vibrant gradient background, creating clear visual breaks.

technique_notes: The site employs a custom smooth-scroll or scroll-jacking library (like locomotive-scroll) to create a distinct scrolling experience where a fixed left-hand branding and navigation panel remains static while the main content area on the right scrolls independently. Content sections within the right panel are revealed with a staggered fade-in and subtle upward translation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.
Large, impactful headings are achieved by setting text in a very bold, wide sans-serif typeface, often with generous letter-spacing, to command attention and define content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, wide sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing the bold typography to breathe.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, high-contrast split-screen layout with a fixed, branded left panel and an independently scrolling right content area. This, combined with the oversized, bold typography and vibrant gradient accents, creates a highly dynamic and editorial feel that is far from a generic template.
